vault_wide_correction.what: The host's surname was wrong in 61 occurrences across 48 files. The correct name is Александр СИНЧУКОВ; the studio is НЕЧАЕВ СИНЧУКОВ, which is what the channel handle NSDSGN stands for; and he is a CO-principal rather than the sole one, which the vault had implicitly assumed away.
vault_wide_correction.evidence: He introduces himself in a MANUAL caption track: 'меня зовут СИНЧУКОВ Александр, соруководитель студии НЕЧАЕВ СИНЧУКОВ'. Four of five transcripts say 'Син-'; ZERO say 'Сенчугов'. The studio name provides independent structural corroboration of the handle.
vault_wide_correction.why_it_is_logged_rather_than_silently_fi: The form originated in my own Round 1 extraction. In ROUND 4 a source rendered it correctly, I NOTICED, and I OVERRODE it - writing that 'the vault's established form from 17 prior instances is retained'. Those 17 instances were 17 COPIES OF ONE DECISION OF MINE, not 17 independent attestations. I treated the vault's internal consistency as evidence about the outside world when the consistency was entirely downstream of a single unverified choice.
vault_wide_correction.generalisable_rule: An 'established form' is only evidence if its instances are INDEPENDENT. Count sources, not occurrences. Where a vault-wide convention traces to one intake decision, a single contrary primary observation outweighs any number of internal repetitions.
vault_wide_correction.honesty_note: ONE transcript - the 2022 auto track, all-lowercase and unpunctuated - does render 'Сенчуков', and is almost certainly where my error came from. So the fix rests on weight of evidence, not unanimity, and that is recorded rather than glossed.

second_correction.what: In Round 4 I recorded the light-group reconciliation ('the tolerable number of groups is set by whether a scene can collapse them into one action') as a synthesis I had constructed from a 2022 cap and a 2024 practice.
second_correction.actually: He stated both halves himself in January 2022: 'если вы хотите БОЛЬШЕ ТРЁХ ГРУПП освещения, то хорошо эти группы ОБЪЕДИНИТЬ [в] УМНЫЙ ДОМ... иначе ПИАНИНО ИЗ ВЫКЛЮЧАТЕЛЕЙ'.
second_correction.generalisable_rule: Before crediting a synthesis to the reading, check whether an earlier source in the same channel already made it. A channel's back catalogue can contain the resolution to what looks like its own contradiction, and a multi-round intake is exactly the process that hides it.

dating_corrections.detail: Round 5's earliest source (2022-01-26) predates everything else the vault holds from this channel and moved four findings backwards: the matte-paint burnishing MECHANISM (vault had 2026-04), the light-group cap AND its resolution, push-to-open rejected with four MECHANICAL reasons (vault had 2024-07 on dirt grounds), and the never-used exercise equipment (now with a 90% figure).
dating_corrections.systematic_bias_revealed: A vault built round by round will systematically MIS-DATE findings toward the round that first noticed them. Processing order is not chronology. For any channel where dating matters - trend claims, price claims, 'he changed his mind' claims - process the OLDEST titles EARLY rather than leaving them as the dregs.
